words: somewhere in / somewhere past / somewhere beyond
whisper/whispering/whispered as ambient description (whispering wind, trees, shadows) — "whispered" stays available as a speech verb for actual whispered dialogue
patterns: "the wind whistled / howled / blew through / swept"
"the clock ticked / chimed" / "a clock ticked somewhere"
